subject: Constant entry
notes: kb/Work PB1232 (w1006c). cite.py --check 13.10.3 "All subscripts of data-name-1 and data-name-2 shall be literals" -> OK SR3. The screen in BindConstantLength (one screen for LENGTH OF and BYTE-LENGTH OF since PB1227) admits integer-literal tokens and, per SR2 ('constant-name-1 may be used anywhere that a format specifies a literal of the class and category of constant-name-1') with GR1/GR3, a subscript word naming an INTEGER constant: LENGTH OF E (KI) = 3, BYTE-LENGTH OF C OF R (KI 1) = 4, LENGTH OF E (KJ) with KJ = KI + 1 = 3. Still refused: a data-name subscript (LENGTH OF E (I)), and a NON-integer constant (KD = 1.5 -> negative pb1232-constant-length-noninteger-subscript, COBOL1547 SR3). || editions corrected from '2002' to 2002,2014,2023 (kb/Work PB3173, S0b; DESIGN-conformance-suite.md §6 step 0): a constant-entry rule; the constant entry (level 01 CONSTANT) is a COBOL-2002 introduction. cite.py --check 13.10.3 "The length of data-name-1 or data-name-2 shall not be dependent" OK.
